# Meshvise

> Industrial supervision (SCADA) platform, hosted on the customer's premises. Thirteen industrial protocols included, a published price independent of point count, data in a standard PostgreSQL database readable with Excel, Power BI or Grafana. Designed and built by one person, an industrial digitalisation engineer.

Meshvise connects PLCs, sensors and meters, records everything in a database the customer owns, and alerts when something drifts. Built for small-to-mid industrial and commercial sites where legacy per-point-priced SCADA platforms are too expensive, and for sites that have no transverse supervision at all and still run on notebooks and spreadsheets.

## What Meshvise is

- A web-based industrial supervision (SCADA) platform, self-hosted via Docker Compose.
- Acquisition engine with thirteen protocols: Modbus TCP, Modbus RTU, OPC UA, BACnet/IP, Siemens S7, MQTT, EtherNet/IP, Beckhoff ADS, REST, WebSocket, Webhook, Sparkplug B, MTConnect. All included, no module per brand.
- Backend in Python (FastAPI, asyncpg, SQLAlchemy 2); database PostgreSQL 16 + TimescaleDB; internal MQTT bus (Mosquitto); frontend Vue 3.
- Closed-source commercial product, distributed as compiled Docker images. Licence enforced by offline-verified Ed25519 JWT, no phone-home.

## What Meshvise is not

- Not a functional-safety / SIL system. Safety stays in the certified PLC. Meshvise supervises, records and alerts.
- Not a predictive-maintenance or machine-learning tool. It does not predict failures.
- Not a CMMS, not an MES, not a standalone BI tool. It exposes its data to those tools through standard SQL.

## Capabilities shipped

- Automatic equipment discovery; persistent store-and-forward buffer on network loss; data quality on every value.
- History in PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB, per-point policy, configurable retention, direct read access for Excel, Power BI, Grafana.
- Alarms: conditions, severities, delays, hysteresis, acknowledgement, shelving, email and webhook notification, full journal.
- Composable dashboards (seventeen component types), browser-drawn synoptics animated by live values, live views by hierarchy.
- Visual logic by linked blocks (calculation, comparison, timing, scheduling, control, alarm), or Python.
- Traceability: every configuration change versioned and signed, diff between dates, revert, deployment overlays on curves, immutable journal of every command sent to equipment.
- Access: read-only / operator / administrator roles, OIDC single sign-on, second factor, API keys, OPC UA server for exposing data to other systems.
- Operations: component health page, Prometheus metrics, restart without the database available, no outbound telemetry, works without internet.

## Continuity ("what if Meshvise disappears?")

- Data is in a standard PostgreSQL database on the customer's server, documented schema. It does not need Meshvise to be read.
- The stack is standard (PostgreSQL, MQTT, Docker); any integrator can take over operations.
- Source code escrow offered in the contract, triggered on cessation of business.
- Source-code audit under NDA available on request.

## Pricing (excl. VAT, France, annual billing)

- Online demo: €0, public, no sign-up (coming).
- 7-day trial: €0, full application on the customer's infrastructure, limits 5 drivers / 15 machines / 500 points, all protocols. Read-only on expiry, data kept.
- On-Premise: €2,400 per year, whatever the number of points, machines or screens. Commissioning quoted separately, based on the number of devices to connect. OIDC included, updates for twelve months, email support within two business days.
- Managed operations: on request, not yet available.

## Who it is for

Managing directors of small and mid-size industrial companies, maintenance managers, production and methods managers, quality managers preparing audits, and system integrators / engineering firms who want a supervision they can price before the quote.

## Who it is not for

Very large multi-country groups with twelve-month buying cycles, projects under fifty points, functional safety.
